import random, sys, subprocess, struct

random.seed(999)
def c_table(entries, ms, helper='/workspace/tmp/ftabtest/ftab'):

    for a,l,h in entries:
        payload += a.to_bytes(16,'big'); payload.append(l)
    p = subprocess.run([helper], input=bytes(payload), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)

    return [list(vals[i*129:(i+1)*129]) for i in range(129)]
bad=0
